title: tc-priority-list
description:
Topics or projects by priority – a priority badge, name, owner and team, momentum, coverage, what's open and the
work in flight – with health filters and optional groups per priority.

heading.description: The heading, and the list's name

items.description: The topics or projects, in the order to show them (within a group when grouped)

hide.description: Built-in columns to leave out of the header and the rows – space-separated as an attribute, e.g. `hide="coverage open work"`; the name and the other columns take the room. "health" leaves the health word out from under each name (screen readers still hear it); with no owner either, the name stands alone

figures.description: More columns after Work, in order, filled from each row's `figures`

grouped.description: Puts the rows under a header per priority; rows without one come last, under no header

filter.description: The health shown. Changed by the user unless a tc-filter-change listener calls preventDefault()

noFilters.description: Shows the health filter chips with their counts

tiers.description: The tiers' names by number, merged over the defaults (Top priority, High, Medium, Watching)

healthLabels.description: The healths' names, merged over the defaults (At risk, Watch, On track)

keepTrendLine.description: Keeps the momentum line at every width where the momentum column shows (it still folds below 400px), at its full width beside the change; the name takes the difference and truncates sooner – for short names such as codes

momentumLabel.description: The momentum column's heading, also read before each row's change: "Trend"

openUnit.description: What's open, after its count: "5 gaps"

openUnitOne.description: What's open when there's one: "1 gap"; `open-unit` when unset

workUnit.description: The short unit after the work count: "3·wk"

workLabel.description: The work count in words, for screen readers: "3 work items"

coverageWarn.description: Coverage under this share, from 0 to 1, is drawn in the danger colour

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "de"; by default the browser's

team.description: The team or group it belongs to

priority.description: Its tier, from 1 (the top) to 4; named by `tiers`. A row without one shows its `badge` instead

badge.description: A short code shown in the badge when there's no priority, e.g. "CEC"

badgeImage.description: A logo shown in the badge column in place of `badge` when there's no priority – an image URL (through safeMediaUrl); `badge` stays as the screen-reader text. Missing, unsafe or failing to load, the code shows

trend.description: Recent values for the momentum line, oldest first

change.description: The change over the period as a fraction: -0.14 is ▼ 14%

open.description: How many are open (gaps, issues, questions)

work.description: How many pieces of work are in flight

figures.description: Values for the list's `figures` columns, by column id; a missing one leaves its cell empty

PriorityColumn.description: What `hide` can leave out: the built-in columns, and "health" – the health word under each name

label.description: The column's heading, and what screen readers say after a value, e.g. "This mo."

unit.description: A short unit after each value, as the work count has: "3·pp"

width.description: The column's width in px, for a heading longer than "This mo."; unset is 56. The name column gives up the room

PriorityFigureColumn.description: One more column after Work, filled from each row's `figures`
